technical.summary: Strong technical confluence with price above all key moving averages and bullish momentum indicators, but overbought RSI(9) and moderate ADX trend strength present pullback risk in neutral sector environment.

fundamental.summary: DHI shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 78 days.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity with small trades from non-senior members, neutral market sentiment (AAII bearish-leaning, Fear/Greed at 61), and no recent news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 175.68 crisis level, FOMC event today, macro_score -6) creates severe headwinds for Consumer Discretionary; earnings in 78 days adds moderate event risk but secondary to acute market dysfunction.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical confluence (price above all major MAs, RSI 9 bullish crossover, MACD positive histogram) with moderate entry quality provides tactical short-term momentum setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro dysfunction (VIX crisis 175.68, inverted yield curve, FOMC today, macro_score -6) combined with overbought technicals (RSI 76.48, Stoch 78.89), zero fundamental conviction, and Consumer Discretionary sector headwinds create asymmetric downside risk that overwhelms technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows strong momentum confluence with price above all major MAs and bullish MACD crossover, but this is severely undermined by macro crisis conditions and overbought extremes that create asymmetric downside risk.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis level (175.68), inverted yield curve, and FOMC event today create acute macro dysfunction that will likely trigger sharp Consumer Discretionary sector selloff, negating technical gains and catching overbought position in drawdown.
decision.recommended_exit: N/A — avoid entry; if forced to trade, use atr_trail_1x with tight stop at RSI(9) < 50 or macro event trigger.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical bull case overwhelmed by macro risk, fundamental weakness, and sentiment void.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 50 Consumer Discretionary positions with existing DHI exposure; sector concentration + macro headwinds + zero fundamental conviction make additional sizing unjustifiable despite technical signals.
